name: Aegis
title_zh: 先给基线再动手的架构感知编码副驾
tagline_zh: 长任务里代码越写越偏？它每一步都拿证据对照基线，漂移当场拦下，适合重构老项目或跨多文件改动的你。
tagline_en: Long tasks drift? It verifies each step against a baseline, flags divergence early. Built for refactors and.
desc_en: Make AI coding agents architecture-aware: baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked, and safe across long tasks.
why_zh: 不靠感觉，靠证据链：先立基线，再验证每一步改动是否偏离，长任务里漂移无处遁形。
why_en: Evidence over intuition: establish baseline, verify each change, catch drift before it compounds across long tasks.
limit_zh: 只适用于 AI 编码代理的架构审查，不处理单文件小改动；需要先有可运行的基线版本，否则无从比对。
limit_en: For AI coding agents only; needs a runnable baseline. Not for single-file tweaks; no baseline means no drift check.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Architecture-aware coding copilot that checks drift.
